title: Severe Flash Flood & River Spate Warning
title_hi: भीषण अचानक बाढ़ एवं नदी उफान चेतावनी
description: Continuous heavy upstream precipitation has pushed major river water levels past Danger Mark. Inundation of low-lying settlements imminent. Evacuate to designated multi-purpose shelters immediately.
description_hi: लगातार भारी बारिश के कारण मुख्य नदियों का जलस्तर खतरे के निशान को पार कर गया है। निचले इलाकों में पानी भरने की आशंका है। तुरंत सुरक्षित आश्रय स्थलों पर जाएं।
instructions: Move to upper floors or higher ground immediately.
Switch off main electricity and LPG cylinder valves.
Do not attempt to cross flooded causeways, bridges, or culverts on foot or vehicle.
Dial 1070 for State Disaster Relief Force (SDRF) evacuation assistance.

title: High-Intensity Thunderstorm & Cloud-to-Ground Lightning
title_hi: तीव्र आंधी-तूफान एवं वज्रपात (बिजली गिरने) की चेतावनी
description: Extreme convective activity with severe lightning strikes and gale winds reaching 70-85 km/h. High risk to life in open areas and under tin-roof structures.
description_hi: तीव्र संवहनी बादलों के कारण भारी आकाशीय बिजली और 70-85 किमी/घंटा की गति से आंधी चलने का गंभीर खतरा। खुले स्थानों में न रहें।
instructions: Stay indoors away from windows, tin sheds, and metal fencing.
Never take shelter under standalone trees or near electric transmission poles.
Unplug electronic appliances and computers.
If caught outdoors without shelter, adopt the lightning squat posture.

title: Depression / Severe Cyclonic Storm Advisory
description: Deep depression intensifying over sea with squally winds 90-110 kmph gusting to 125 kmph. Storm surge of 1.5 to 2.0 meters likely to inundate low lying coastal pockets.
description_hi: समुद्र में गहरा दबाव चक्रवाती तूफान में तब्दील हो रहा है। तटीय क्षेत्रों में 90-110 किमी/घंटा की तेज हवाएं और समुद्री लहरों के उफान का खतरा है।
instructions: Total suspension of fishing operations in marine and inland channels.
Inspect home roof ties and board up glass windows.
Keep 72 hours of dry rations, ORS packets, torch, and medicines ready.
Cooperate with local authorities for early evacuation to Cyclone Shelters.

title: Landslide Hazard Warning along Hill Roads & Slopes
title_hi: पहाड़ी ढलानों एवं मार्गों पर भूस्खलन की चेतावनी
description: Ground saturation index above 85% with continuous slope seepage. High vulnerability of debris flows and rockfalls across national highways and hillside settlements.
description_hi: लगातार वर्षा से मिट्टी में नमी 85% से अधिक। राजमार्गों और पहाड़ी ढलानों पर भूस्खलन और चट्टान खिसकने का गंभीर खतरा। यात्रा स्थगित रखें।
instructions: Avoid travel on ghat and mountain roads after dark.
Listen for unusual sounds like cracking trees or rolling rocks.
Evacuate downslope buildings if cracks appear in ground or walls.
Contact DEOC control room on 1077 for road clearance updates.

title: Severe Air Quality Index (AQI 380+) Smog Advisory
source: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) - GRAP Stage IV
description: PM2.5 concentrations exceeding 10x WHO safe threshold due to surface temperature inversion and stagnant winds. Severe impact on respiratory, cardiac, and pediatric health.
description_hi: हवा की गति धीमी होने और प्रदूषण कणों के जमाव के कारण एक्यूआई बेहद खराब स्तर पर। बुजुर्ग और बच्चे बाहरी गतिविधियों से बचें।
instructions: Wear certified N95 / FFP2 respirators outdoors.
Do not engage in early morning or late evening outdoor jogging/strenuous exercise.
Keep inhalers accessible for patients with asthma or COPD.
Use indoor wet mopping instead of dry sweeping to suppress dust.

title: Heat Wave to Severe Heat Wave Warning
title_hi: लू (हीटवेव) से भीषण लू की चेतावनी
description: Maximum temperatures hovering 43-46°C with dry westerly winds. Increased vulnerability to heat cramps, dehydration, and sun stroke.
description_hi: दिन का तापमान 43 से 46 डिग्री सेल्सियस तक पहुंचने की संभावना। दोपहर 12 से 3 बजे के बीच धूप में निकलने से बचें और पर्याप्त पानी पिएं।
instructions: Drink adequate fluids (ORS, Lemon water, Chhach, Coconut water) frequently.
Wear light-coloured, loose-fitting cotton clothing and cover head with cloth.
Never leave children, elderly, or pets inside parked vehicles.
If someone shows symptoms of disorientation or dry hot skin, apply cold sponges and dial 108.
